title: Partita
identity: Claude Pascal’s Partita is catalogued as an alto saxophone and piano work published by Éditions Combre as C05990 in the Arc en Ciel series, dedicated to Jean Ledieu. The catalog and conservatory library record identify the edition, but original-work provenance was not established.

evidence.claim: Library catalog gives Paris: Éditions Combre, 1999, alto saxophone and piano, score and part, Arc en Ciel series, dedicated to Jean Ledieu.
evidence.source_name: Royal Conservatoire Antwerp saxophone library list

evidence.claim: Retail catalog identifies C05990, alto saxophone and piano, score and part, eight pages. Difficulty labels vary between retailers and are omitted from assessment.

University of North Texas College of Music performance book lists Partita by Claude Pascal in a student performance program. The indexed listing does not identify this work’s saxophone/piano instrumentation clearly, so it is not used as firm saxophone program evidence.
evidence.source_name: University of North Texas Digital Library

collection_flag: Alto saxophone and piano edition; original versus arrangement status is unresolved. No age-specific or pedagogical audience claim was verified.
